line: O-1 Conflict Evidence & Safety Policy Closure, SSCTR-NCC-01 + SEC-NCC-02 (claude/v1-core-conflict-policy, from f40fbe1 = COACHINGCORE-V1-CORE-SAFETY-FREEZE-5)
note: The tests that fail on this line and passed on f40fbe1. None is edited: each file is bound by an earlier freeze. FREEZE-5's 31 failures are unchanged in title; 29 fail at the same location (see QRE-O1-03(a) below). Successors are in test/v1core-o1-successors.test.mjs. Each runs the frozen test from a temporary copy with only the listed substitutions, each matched exactly once. QRE-O1-03(a): two of the 31 now fail one assertion earlier, because the first O-1 move masks the old one: v1rws-fix-forward.test.mjs:285 now fails at :298 (was :316), and the lineage EASY matrix at :203 (was :205). Both are covered by successor chains that pass whole: closure-2 successor-fix-forward, then this ledger's successors.

entries.title: F1: the record rebuilt again and again, restored from JSON, and the same late batch re-sent: what is in force does not move
entries.contract: O-1 P1/P5: a report refused for a head-on conflict is kept as a voice of the flagged row, with its input hash
entries.before: the re-sent late report W was refused again (IDENTITY_QUARANTINED_BY_CONFLICT)
entries.after: W is a voice the record holds, so its re-send is EXACT_REPLAY. Nothing is admitted and what is in force does not move (the test's other assertions are unchanged)
entries.sporting: none (the row stays flagged, out of dose)
entries.safety: the refused report's content is kept for SB-1 (P6)

entries.title: F3: a later agreeing plain report of the disputed session is refused by the quarantine, never merged into the conflicted row
entries.contract: O-1 P1: a report refused because its execution is already in dispute is kept as a voice of the flagged row in force
entries.before: the row in force read exactly as before the report
entries.after: the report is still refused (same reason) and never merged. The amounts, flags and other voices are as before, and P is an added voice of the flagged row
entries.safety: the voice is heard by SB-1

entries.title: SUCCESSOR closure-2 · lineage matrix: the word that withholds each run, the reports in force and the history reference
entries.before: row '19 conflict: the app first (other minutes, lists), the import refused, then the app corrects itself to the whole' read REPORT_NOT_CARRIED, COMPLETED, with the import's refused report lost
entries.after: the import's refused report is a kept voice. The app's correction to the whole agrees with it and merges it, so row 19 reads exactly as row 10 (the same statements with no correction), as row 08 already did: DISTANCE_DISPUTED, partial at the first file, history 'first'. The successor adds [19 -> 10] to the matrix's own AS_IF map, so the as-if reading (word, wholeRow, every band edge, history reference, what is withheld) is also asserted. Rows 18 and 21 stay CONFLICTED, which this matrix does not assert; v1core-o1-conflict-evidence.test.mjs does
entries.sporting: row 19, both families: completion credit COMPLETED -> PARTIAL (as rows 08/10). LONG w+2 QUALITY:34 -> EASY:65, EASY w+3 EASY 70 -> 65. Run-history fact kept (first file). Rows 18 and 21: CONFLICTED kept, run-history fact 1 -> 0, the same one-step hold. Row 18 LONG long-run sizing source S2 365 -> 360 s/km, with minutes and km unchanged (SSCTR O-O1-1). Every move lowers dose (evidence/lineage-diff.txt)
